<p>Get the name of a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinebasicblock">MachineBasicBlock</a>.</p>


<p>Get the name of a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinebasicblock">MachineBasicBlock</a>. It's templated so that including from CodeGen is unnecessary (that would be a layering issue).</p>


<p>This is used mainly for debug output. The name is similar to <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinebasicblock/#ad2a8da74fd4e4c892018c56c977addee">MachineBasicBlock::getFullName()</a>, but skips the name of the function.</p>
